purpose: Test input-conditioned signed target-code correspondence with source-member columns and query-independent support.
budget: One target, <=600driver seconds, same existing model; no training/download.
statistics_unit: Paired verb/noun context families, development only
threshold_source_split: Four fixed published SFC Figure18 source features, selected before outputs
scope: New development parameterization, not a novelty/confirmation claim. Exact-source and target-reconstruction-read variants identify the reading dependence.
